description: OCD's closed CarrierConfig key list (rule round 30): the public schema's keys (origin ocd_schema), every key of the Google lane (google) and the keys of the per-device records (device_record), each with its type, its group (A: the emergency-call keys no test can decide; B: the metered lists; X6: the SMS-to-MMS keys of the MMS-ended networks) and the IMS stack fork it exists in. generated/ocd-dataset/profiles.json carries a copy as `keys`.
